author: rap36case
notes_extra: Shilen, 1 in 10. MagnetoSpeed. 0.015 jump. Compressed. He wrote 215gr HB. Estimated 1489 fps at 1000 yards is not a muzzle velocity.

author: rap36case
notes_extra: Same test. The group opened to 1 inch. No velocity for this charge.

author: rap36case
notes_extra: Same charge, chronographed again at a 1000-yard practice. He wrote Shilen 26 in, 1 to 10. No pressure signs.

author: Capt. Oblivious
notes_extra: No charge. 1 in 10 twist. He also shoots 200 gr Hybrids in a 300WM, which is a different bullet.

author: Greg Brooks
notes_extra: Mean velocity, single-digit SD. Large rifle Lapua brass. 32 in 10-twist Bartlein, throated very long. Trued Remington action. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 308.

author: Keith Glasscock
notes_extra: F/TR. 10-twist Krieger 30 in. The ~2550 fps was in the March 15 post; the 41.5 gr charge and Win brass were the next day. A remembered start around 37 gr at about 3.1 OAL is not stored.

author: RMagee
notes_extra: 26 in Krieger 1-10 5R. 0.015 jump, just over magazine length. SD 4. 300WSM match reamer, 0.335 neck. He named Norma brass on Aug 29, 2014. Stiff load, bolt lift was not sticky.

author: LoanHarvey
notes_extra: Krieger barrel. Magazine length, 0.040 off the lands. SD 7. He wrote 300 WM.

author: Stingray
notes_extra: 13 thousandths off. No velocity on this sentence. The same post gives 43.8 gr Varget at 2660 fps for the 200.20x, which is a different bullet. The original post names the rifle as .308.

author: dcali
notes_extra: Showed promise. Freebore about 0.200. He called it a pretty hot load in a shorter freebore. The original post names the rifle as .308.

author: rpierce
notes_extra: Node for his 215 Bergers. 0.003 neck tension. Ladder at 580 yards was 1.6 in across that charge range. He did not name the cartridge in the post; the thread at that point is 300 wsm. 23.5 in Benchmark carbon.

author: rpierce
notes_extra: Three rounds in the middle of the 63.5-64.7 gr node. 2.1 in group at 840 yards.

author: moondog
notes_extra: No charge. ES 9. Hornady brass. He wrote 215s. The thread is 300 PRC, and the day before he wrote Lapua 300PRC brass for a new lot.

author: moondog
notes_extra: Go-to Retumbo load in virgin Lapua, 40 fps slower than the Hornady load, ES 4. 28 in Bartlein, 9 twist. No charge written.

author: moondog
notes_extra: Pressure check the same morning as the 215 Berger Retumbo ladder. Slight ejector marks. He stopped there. The 220 Bergers mentioned afterward were a separate plan.

author: moondog
notes_extra: Seating test of the Lapua Retumbo load. He wrote 215 Bergers at -.045, ES 3. The charge was not repeated. Shot at 500 yards.
